title: Background Contexts & Merging Changes

docs.title: Using Core Data in the background

hints: Do the work inside `await background.perform { … }` and return object IDs.
Save the background context; the view context merges automatically when configured.
On the main context, re-fetch with `existingObject(with: id)`.
jsBridge: Import on a background context, save, and let the main (view) context merge the changes. It's like doing heavy work in a Web Worker and posting results back, except Core Data merges object graphs, not messages.

compass.q: Web Worker computes, posts a message, the main thread updates state. How is `automaticallyMergesChangesFromParent` like that?
Passing an `NSManagedObject` across contexts crashes or corrupts. What do you pass instead (`NSManagedObjectID`)?
Merge conflicts when both contexts edit the same object: what's `NSMergeByPropertyObjectTrumpMergePolicy`?
